correctness.rationale: The proof uses full-universal-family presentations over the stable delta locus, exact Hom/Ext vanishing for distinct stable representations of the same isotropic dimension vector, and stable framing components modulo separate scalar automorphisms. The rank-two bundle is explicitly split for both Kronecker framings, while bundles on the t>=1 affine punctured projective lines are free over a PID. Divisor-class localization gives Pic(F_k(P1)) exactly Z for k=2 or Z/2 for all k>=3. A determinant-divisibility argument obstructs factor and product trivialization in A1(b); the connected ordered configuration cover has full symmetric-group monodromy. The Smith normal forms for k=2..8 were independently checked using exact integer arithmetic; they corroborate, but do not replace, the universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural geometry is the smooth locus of the fibration of five infinite series of Fano varieties of every even dimension. Fiberwise isomorphism alone does not distinguish the globally twisted and untwisted isotrivial bundles. The complete four-versus-one dichotomy, non-two-divisible determinant classes, and full ruling monodromy provide structural global information useful for studying sections, Brauer obstructions and characteristic classes. The result is not a textbook substitution or arbitrary finite parameter slice; it treats the entire classified series. It does not calculate Brauer classes of the unordered fibrations or extend to singular strata.
